items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Bea was one of the main instigators of that thing. Bea, Duke's woman or whatever you want to call her.

ctx.x: I saw references to him in 1938, in Ulanov's book and after that I don't know -- I never knew him.

Well he was -- that was probably about that time, anyway, but and he was with Duke night and day, Duke kept that man up all hours. But that's the only time she got to see her husband. They was hiding the man. And Bea was one of the main instigators of that thing. Bea, Duke's woman or whatever you want to call her. And he was -- he was - see when he -- something happened years ago between he and his wife and he's been terrible with the -- with women ever since, I mean like he's always trying to make somebody's…
Bea said once that he could not stand to see a man and a woman happy together.
